changes: Six-room branching tree with reciprocal doors and the final arena at maximum depth.
Thirty-two random bending paths share the door and conga tunnel routine.
Protected routes use a byte mask; hazard growth uses a single specialized frontier.
Terrain and static props share one rendering pass; tiles use their native orientation.
Music, palette and theme derive from one random word with matching dev/release random consumption.
Shared needle clock, fixed 24-cell hazard target and mean decoration density.
Remove redundant release spawn/gate metadata and atlas compositing reset.
Retune entropy packing precision and learning rate.
tradeoffs: Room topology and layouts change; topology is a tree without loops.
Per-tile floor/wall rotation and reflection removed.
Hazard patch target sizes and needle timing no longer vary by room.
validation: 2,000 room seeds and 1,000 full levels passed.
1,000 additional dungeon graphs preserve a furthest-depth final arena.
All npm test stages passed; combat and thrust stages rerun after isolating generated uranium from the empty combat test arena.
harness_fix: Combat harness clears generated loot along with its synthetic room terrain and enemies, preventing incidental uranium deaths during pathfinding checks.
